# Model card: cognitive-stage assessment (fusion-v3)

**Research use only. Not a diagnostic device.** This page is generated by `tools/build_model_card.py` from committed
result files; it is the single source for the Model Card page of the app.

## What it is
A research prototype that stages cognitive status (CN, EMCI, LMCI, AD) from clinical assessments and a T1 MRI, using a
frozen system (freeze commit `8f351b6`): five-seed clinical CatBoost specialists, a logistic-regression
MRI specialist (six volume ratios, a CNN AD score "ALZ", brain-age gap, age, sex), a DeepBrainNet brain-age model, a
3D ResNet CNN (15 checkpoints) and a KAN fusion layer that gives the final stage probabilities and an AD probability.
Severity is the expected stage index, a number from 0 to 3, computed from the stage probabilities.
127 artifacts are hash-checked against `src/assessment/artifacts/registry.json` before every run.

## Modes
| Mode | What it is |
|---|---|
| FULL | fusion model with scan and clinical inputs |
| CLINICAL_ONLY | fusion model run without scan inputs: the frozen KAN run with the missing-scan inputs it was trained with; no MRI panels, no brain age, severity hidden |
| MRI_ONLY | MRI specialist only (AD probability; no stage): no 4-stage prediction and no severity |

If a scan fails quality control, a FULL request is downgraded to CLINICAL_ONLY and the report says so.

## Probabilities
Stage and AD probabilities are the frozen models' raw softmax outputs, shown as **model probability**. They have not
been adjusted after training, and their reliability as frequencies has not been measured.

## Frozen internal results (single run on the held-out ADNI test split, n = 123)
| System | Accuracy | Balanced accuracy | Macro-F1 | AD vs rest AUC |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fusion model (final) | 0.764 | 0.773 | 0.764 | 0.992 |
| Clinical specialist | 0.797 | 0.780 | 0.771 | 0.995 |
| MRI specialist (MRI-only mode) | 0.504 | 0.472 | 0.438 | 0.873 |

Severity means by stage for the fusion model rise monotonically (0.00, 1.40, 1.77, 2.87).
These numbers come from one frozen run on an internal ADNI split, `frozen_run/test_results.json`. They are not an external
validation, and the differences between the fusion model and the clinical specialist are within the bootstrap intervals in
that file. The 4-class metrics of the "MRI specialist (MRI-only mode)" row do not apply to MRI-only reports, which carry no stage;
see the dated correction under External validation.

## Reference population
Per-stage ranges (p25, p50, p75) and the pooled CN volume percentiles in the report come from the **569 clinical-train subjects**
only (CN 133, EMCI 217, LMCI 114, AD 105).
Volume percentiles are **not age/sex-adjusted**. The frozen models were fitted on the train and validation subjects together, so the
reference tables describe a subset of the data the models saw.

## SynthSeg volumes for new scans
The MRI specialist was trained on FreeSurfer 5.1 volumes. For uploaded scans the engine uses SynthSeg volumes instead. Agreement was
checked descriptively on 25 train scans (the raw native scans still on disk number far fewer than the full cohort, so the
intervals are wide). This is not a validation.

| Ratio (volume / ICV) | ICC(2,1) [95% CI] | Bias vs FreeSurfer 5.1 | Percentile shown |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hippocampus | 0.85 [0.69, 0.91] | +9% | yes |
| Ventricles | 0.89 [0.81, 0.93] | +21% | no (low agreement) |
| WholeBrain | 0.52 [0.16, 0.70] | +1% | yes |
| Entorhinal | 0.15 [-0.01, 0.26] | +31% | no (low agreement) |
| Fusiform | 0.28 [-0.21, 0.66] | +3% | no (low agreement) |
| MidTemp | 0.33 [0.10, 0.54] | -12% | no (low agreement) |

Display rule: a percentile is shown only for ratios with ICC(2,1) of at least 0.50 and absolute bias of at most 10%. The other ratios
are shown raw, labelled "low agreement with training volumes, no percentile". The "MRI changed the stage" flag is not shown on SynthSeg
reports, and every such report carries a warning quoting these numbers. ADNI demo cases use the exact FreeSurfer volumes and the stored
m1 outputs, so they are not affected.

## Explanations and their status
Explanations are post-hoc and carry the pre-registered validation status:
- CNN attribution map: sanity: cascading randomisation (FAIL); sanity: region deletion (FAIL). It is shown in the technical view only, as "attribution density, not evidence of disease location",
  with both sanity failures labelled. It is not shown in the clinician view.
- Clinical SHAP: plausibility: CDRSB (FAIL); plausibility: MMSE (WEAK).
- MRI-specialist SHAP: stability (WEAK); plausibility: ventricles (FAIL).
- Fusion-layer Shapley values: plausibility: CDRSB (WEAK); plausibility: MMSE (WEAK).
Clinical explanations never refer to MRI features.

## Limitations
- ADNI only. Scanners, protocols and populations outside ADNI are a domain shift. Uploaded scans carry a domain-shift caveat.
- The staging task is hardest for LMCI (see the per-stage results in `frozen_run/test_results.md`); the MRI specialist detects AD better than it stages MCI.
- m1 preprocessing is not bit-reproducible: repeated runs on the same scan differ slightly.
- The system is cross-sectional. Reports for several visits of one person are independent assessments, not a forecast.
- Missing clinical inputs are replaced by training medians and listed in the report; required inputs (CDRSB, MMSE, ADAS13) cannot be missing.
- Demo cases come from the ADNI train or validation split and were in the training data of the frozen system, so their outputs are in-sample.
  The upload demonstration uses an ADNI scan to show the upload path; it is a demonstration, not a validation.
- The trained weights and any subject-level data are not part of any public release.

## External validation (OASIS-1, cross-sectional)
<!-- OASIS_RESULTS_MARKER -->
Data were provided by OASIS-1: Cross-Sectional: Principal Investigators: D. Marcus, R. Buckner, J. Csernansky, J. Morris; P50 AG05681, P01 AG03991, P01 AG026276, R01 AG021910, P20 MH071616, U24 RR021382. Citation: Marcus et al., J Cogn Neurosci 2007;19(9):1498-1507, https://doi.org/10.1162/jocn.2007.19.9.1498

The frozen system was run, without any training, tuning, threshold selection or adjustment, on the OASIS-1 cross-sectional cohort of
people aged 60 or older (one scan per person), under the pre-registered protocol `docs/external_validation_protocol.md`
(local tag `oasis-protocol-v1`). All numbers below are generated from `docs/validation/oasis_analysis.json`,
`docs/validation/oasis_domain_shift.json` and `analysis/external_validation/adni_reference.json`; full tables are in
`docs/validation/oasis_results_tables.md`.

H1 (primary): ALZ for CN-like vs dementia, higher score means more impaired. Outcome class **PASS** (registered thresholds: AUC at least 0.75 and CI lower bound above 0.65; FAIL below an AUC of 0.65).

|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 ALZ | 0.874 | [0.795, 0.941] | 30 | 98 |

S6f (mirrored left-right convention, 60 cases, 60 paired): paired ALZ difference (mirrored minus primary) median -0.0218, interquartile range [-0.0636, 0.0068]; 38 lower and 22 higher under the mirrored convention; Spearman between conventions 0.943. Labelled sensitivity; it never replaces the primary result.

S6a (session-level averaging) is not part of the protocol and S6b (OASIS FreeSurfer volumes) was not run.

Same task in the two cohorts (AUC):

| Task | OASIS-1 | ADNI reference (train split) |
|---|---|---|
| ALZ, CDR 0 vs CDR 1 or higher | 0.874 | 0.805 (ADNI CN vs AD) |
| Specialist P(AD), SynthSeg volumes | 0.909 | 0.961 (ADNI CN vs AD) |

The two tasks are not identical: OASIS positives are CDR 1 or higher (clinical diagnosis of probable AD) against CDR 0 elders from a research-centre cohort with screened images, whereas the ADNI reference is CN vs AD under ADNI criteria, from cross-fitted predictions on the training split. The comparison shows that the ranking transfers; it is not a measure of relative performance.

Absolute score levels differ from ADNI, and no ADNI cutoff applies to OASIS.

### What this does and does not show
- Tested: the MRI CNN score (ALZ), the brain-age gap, and the MRI specialist's model probability, for separating CDR 0 from CDR 1 or higher
  and for trends across CDR groups.
- Not tested: the 4-stage output (MRI-only reports have no stage; EMCI and LMCI do not exist in OASIS), the clinical stream (OASIS has no
  such inputs, and CDR is the label), and the fusion layer. These results do not validate staging, severity or the clinical stream.
- Probabilities are model probabilities; their reliability as frequencies was not examined.

### Limitations of this validation
- One scan per person (the first of three or four in the session); averaging over scans was not part of the protocol.
- The left-right convention for the OASIS image files is third-party documented, not documented by OASIS; sensitivity S6f above shows how
  far the result depends on it, for a subset of cases only. S6f does not establish which convention is correct.
- The specialist result (S5) uses SynthSeg volumes, not the FreeSurfer 5.1 volumes it was trained on; agreement between the two is weak for several ratios
  (see the section on SynthSeg volumes).
- Independence of the brain-age model from OASIS is not established: OASIS is not named among its training cohorts, but the published
  training list is incomplete. This also applies to the specialist result (S5), which uses the brain-age gap as an input.
- OASIS-1 is a single cohort from a single research centre and scanner; this is one external check, not a multicentre validation.
- Labels (CDR) and scanner, field strength, acquisition, defacing and image-quality screening differ from ADNI; registration and intensity
  shifts against ADNI are in the domain-shift table of `docs/validation/oasis_results_tables.md`.
- The positive group is small, so intervals are wide; age and sex were not matched, and age-adjusted analyses are reported as S4.
- Clinical-to-scan interval of the CDR label is not analysable from the downloaded files.
- Non-commercial academic use of OASIS data; no OASIS data or subject-level values are part of this repository.

### Dated correction (2026-11-16)
The row "MRI specialist (MRI-only mode)" in the frozen internal results table reports 4-class accuracy, balanced accuracy and macro-F1.
These do not apply to MRI-only reports, which carry no stage; only the AD-versus-rest AUC in that row is relevant to what an MRI-only report shows.
The table is left as generated from the frozen run; this note is the correction.
